title: Overture Maps: the world's buildings, ways, water and land use, as PMTiles archives read tile by tile
credit: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation; building footprints also from Google Open Buildings and Microsoft
licence: ODbL 1.0 for these themes (buildings, transportation, base), with share-alike on a database derived from them; the tiles kept here are a cache and are not redistributed.
citation: Overture Maps Foundation (2026), Overture Maps Data, release 2026-10-21.0, https://overturemaps.org.
format: PMTiles v3 of Mapbox Vector Tiles, levels 0 to 14 (buildings, transportation) and 0 to 13 (base), read by HTTP range requests (data/formats/pmtiles.py) and reduced tile by tile by data/acquisition/world_city.py, kept in data/cache/world-city/.
coverage: The whole Earth, as far as its sources map it. About 2.7 billion footprints. Heights: `height` where known, rare; `num_floors` on 15 to 60 % in the cities tried; elsewhere none, and data/registry/ghs-built-h.json stands in.
